args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

round_money claimed banker's rounding in its docstring but
implemented ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail.
Fix by quantizing with ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build failed because tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (FIN-212), but src/money.py implemented ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring claiming ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

## Changes
- src/money.py: quantize with ROUND_HALF_EVEN instead of ROUND_HALF_UP.

## Verification
- CI run ci-0001 on commit 08d3cd5986 passed (all tests green, including tests/test_money.py).
\n\nattn: @alex
